label: VERIFIED
extraction: Vercel AI Gateway: Production-ready reliability for AI apps. Point existing SDK to gateway. AI SDK usage: import { generateText } from 'ai'; const { text } = await generateText({ model: 'anthropic/claude-opus-5', prompt: 'Hello!' }). Chat Completions API compatible. Provider instance: import { gateway } from 'ai'; model: gateway('openai/gpt-5.4'). Config: baseURL (default https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v4/ai), apiKey (AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY env var), teamIdOrSlug, custom headers. Supports AI Gateway API keys, Vercel personal/app access tokens. Zero Data Retention option. AI SDK 4.2+, OpenAI Responses API. Observability and spend tracking, budgets.
